newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: KSE orders trading halt in Hanjin Heavy.
newsitem.headline: KSE orders trading halt in Hanjin Heavy.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange said it has suspended trading in the shares of Hanjin Heavy Industry for Monday's afternoon session as the company had qualified to be taken off the exchange's supervision list.
The exchange said in a statement that the trading would resume from Tuesday in the second-tier section.
While under court receivership, shares of Hanjin Heavy, a exchange supervision.
The statement said the decision was made after the company announced it had emerged from court receivership after business returned to normal.
The shares last traded at 7,790 won, up 100 won, before the suspension was ordered.
